text_block_list.text: On my day off, while strolling through the shopping arcade on an errand—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Oh, what a coincidence.
The person I happened to bump into was Speed Symboli. She was accompanied by a group of rather distinguished-looking individuals—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ah, allow me to introduce them. They are all trainers invited from overseas.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
C'est l'entraîneur de
notre académie. Un
surdoué, comme vous!

text_block_list.name: Overseas Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Bonjour.
C'est un plaisir de
vous rencontrer.
The people Speed Symboli introduced me to were high-profile figures I had only ever seen in magazines or on TV—far above my level.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —No, truly, you've saved me. You're a lifesaver.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: We were just looking for a spot around here to have a casual lunch. Do you happen to know any?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yes. It seems they want to try Japanese local food... somewhere the locals regularly go to eat.
choice_data_list: I only really know a ramen joint, but...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ah, excellent! Let's go there.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Which shop is it? I believe I scouted out a few ramen spots around here...
choice_data_list: (A-A map?! The amount of handwritten notes is insane...!)

text_block_list.text: After pointing them toward my recommendation, one thing led to another and I ended up tagging along. It was a rare opportunity to speak with renowned trainers, but—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Looks like this is the
place our friend here
recommends.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
我聽講你嗰邊有間幾出名嘅拉麵店喎。
有冇興趣試下呢邊嘅拉麵、
睇下邊邊嘅拉麵好食啲？

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: (Hahaha...!)
What captivated me even more was Speed Symboli's incredible attentiveness. Seamlessly switching between languages, she entertained her guests with humor and poise.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun. Regarding this shoyu ramen, about how much is the "smaller noodle portion"?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: For me. ...Well, you know, ramen can be quite heavy on the stomach.
Throughout the meal, thanks to Speed Symboli's thoughtful consideration naturally pulling me into the conversation, I had a fun and meaningful time. And then—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
――Thus the Japan Cup
began, and we took
on the world.
We arrived at Tokyo Racecourse. As she gave the foreign trainers a lucid, engaging explanation of its history and background...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to continue
in my mother tongue――
Back then, Japan was... falling behind the world.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Back during my active racing days, if you wanted to know the world, you had no choice but to throw yourself right into it—and I was forced to realize the stark difference in caliber.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Learning from those defeats and standing back up... I began this work.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: A long time has passed since then... Compared to those days, how stands the Japanese racing world right now?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: What is the home country of the Japan Cup winners? Where do the recent winners of prestigious international GⅠ races hail from?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yes, we are... already standing shoulder-to-shoulder with all of you. We are ready to share a future together!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Now then. Racing figures from across all nations uniting as one to elevate the racing world... Is that mere idealism? No!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: If we join hands, nothing is impossible! To forge a brand-new future for racing—lend us your strength!

text_block_list.name: Overseas Trainers
text_block_list.text: Yes!
In that moment, beyond all logic... I felt it in my bones. Speed Symboli's words and passion had moved the hearts of everyone present.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Thanks to you, Trainer-kun, it looks like our initiative to broaden the future for horse girls can move forward.
Over the course of just today, before I even realized it, major negotiations that would bring great benefits to the Japanese racing world had concluded. However—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Do you think so? Your proactive attitude while conversing at the ramen shop... and the earnest gaze you showed here.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Your dedication as a Japanese trainer lent immense credibility to my words.
I felt like I had merely tagged along... yet receiving praise from Speed Symboli gave me an uncanny boost of confidence. Above all else—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Happy?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: It's fine, have confidence in yourself. You are exceptional. ...After all, she chose you.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you. Our hope will always be—all of you.
